mission.title: Agent of Change
mission.description: Deliver the General's anti-Exile weapon codes to the Machines' operative.

npc.say: The human, Ymodem, is your contact for this exchange. I am merely here to provide security.

William James also said "We must cheat our foe, politically circumvent his action, not try to change his nature." We won't change the Machines. But we can outmaneuver them, if we are careful. There is much about us that they do not understand. This truce might just prove to be their own undoing--or the making of them, depending on your point of view.
You've done well today. Go now.

phase.briefing:
Yo. Look, I'll be straight with you; this latest assignment really sticks in my craw. But I'm just the middleman, right? You can blame the bleeding-hearts on the Council for this...
It's been decreed that we will share the code for the enhanced anti-Exile weapons that the General gave us with the Machines. Yeah, you heard me; we're giving the Machines weapons. They can only be used against Exiles, so in theory they can only help us bring down the Merovingian from two sides, but... Grr, I just don't like it! I'd write up an official protest, but I know our good Commander Lock would just use it for toilet paper.
Well, what are you waiting for? You've got a disk of weapon codes to pick up, don't you?

enter.say: Got some of the General's men in there. One of them, Hungerford, should have the disk of weapon codes for the Machines. No hostiles in sight.

objective.text: Get the disk of weapon codes from Hungerford

talk.say: Shipment for {player}? Yes, sir, I have it right here.

done.say: That's the stuff. Get on out of there.

phase.briefing: That area of the city is crawling with Exiles right now. The Merovingian must have been tipped off that something is going down. We're conducting a sweep of the area to clear out possible security risks; I've assigned you a sector. If you find any Exiles there, execute them real good.

enter.say: That's the area you're supposed to sweep for Exiles. I'm picking up some programs inside... Could be hostiles.

done.say: Area scans clean. Let's check in with Anome and see if they're ready to do the weapon transfer now.

phase.briefing:
You know, it would just be a real shame if, with your natural clumsiness, you, say, tripped and shattered that disk of weapon codes before you could hand them off to those bloody Machines.
Bah. Okay, no, I didn't say anything.
The Machine redpill operative you're meeting is named "Ymodem"; just give them the disk. Maybe the General put a virus on it for them, but I doubt it. He seems to be almost as soft as the Council.

enter.say: I've got an Agent and redpill in there. Looks like the place. Watch yourself around that Agent.

talk.say: You're the Zionite with the codes, right? Give 'em over! I-- Huh? What's that?

done.say: Hold on, I'm picking up Exile signals in the vicinity. Don't hand that disk over until the area is secure! What's the Agent doing?
Exiles? Here, now?! Quick, give me those codes!
We must destroy the Exile programs.
It looks like that takes care of all the hostiles in the area. Time to go hand over those codes.
Okay, the place is clean. Stop wasting our time and hand over the weapon codes.

objective.text: Give the disk of weapon codes to Ymodem

phase.briefing: I guess that went down about as well as shards of glass can go down anyone's throat. Okay, you're supposed to go talk to someone for a debriefing now. They like to do this after our operatives have to interact with the other side. Little mind games... Making sure you weren't contaminated by the enemy, as it were. Oh, but we've got a truce with the Machines--yeah, whatever.

enter.say: The debrief is in there. I'm reading three redpills.
Hey, it's Ghost! Been a while since I've seen that guy.

talk.say:
{player}... I know that giving weapon codes to the Machines was not easy for you. Your hesitation does you credit. But this was the right thing to do.
William James said "The art of being wise is the art of knowing what to overlook." The Machines are not a perfect ally, or even a desirable one, but our goal at this time is to bring down the Merovingian--and we can count on the Machines to help us do that with those weapon codes.

done.say: Huh. He sounds like he knows what he's doing, at least. That's encouraging.

mission.finish: Feeling better now that you've had your little chat? All cooled down and not going to go on an anti-Machine rampage on us? That's swell. Psychology is a wonderful thing. Just ducky.
